# Needs scope:situation and scope:LR_tsm_county. Puts the county in one sub-region (only if it is not already there)
# and takes it out of the others, then counts it for the legend.
LR_tsm_move_to_hellenistic_effect = {
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_roman }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_themes }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_persian }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_hebrew }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_brythonic }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_galatian }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_foreign }
	scope:situation.situation_sub_region:LR_tsm_hellenistic = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { situation_sub_region_has_county = scope:LR_tsm_county } }
			add_dejure_title_to_sub_region = scope:LR_tsm_county
		}
	}
	scope:situation = { change_variable = { name = LR_tsm_count_hellenistic add = 1 } }
}

LR_tsm_move_to_roman_effect = {
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_hellenistic }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_themes }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_persian }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_hebrew }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_brythonic }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_galatian }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_foreign }
	scope:situation.situation_sub_region:LR_tsm_roman = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { situation_sub_region_has_county = scope:LR_tsm_county } }
			add_dejure_title_to_sub_region = scope:LR_tsm_county
		}
	}
	scope:situation = { change_variable = { name = LR_tsm_count_roman add = 1 } }
}

LR_tsm_move_to_hebrew_effect = {
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_hellenistic }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_roman }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_themes }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_persian }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_brythonic }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_galatian }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_foreign }
	scope:situation.situation_sub_region:LR_tsm_hebrew = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { situation_sub_region_has_county = scope:LR_tsm_county } }
			add_dejure_title_to_sub_region = scope:LR_tsm_county
		}
	}
	scope:situation = { change_variable = { name = LR_tsm_count_hebrew add = 1 } }
}

LR_tsm_move_to_brythonic_effect = {
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_hellenistic }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_roman }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_themes }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_persian }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_hebrew }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_galatian }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_foreign }
	scope:situation.situation_sub_region:LR_tsm_brythonic = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { situation_sub_region_has_county = scope:LR_tsm_county } }
			add_dejure_title_to_sub_region = scope:LR_tsm_county
		}
	}
	scope:situation = { change_variable = { name = LR_tsm_count_brythonic add = 1 } }
}

	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_roman }

LR_tsm_move_to_foreign_effect = {
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_hellenistic }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_roman }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_themes }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_persian }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_hebrew }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_brythonic }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_galatian }
	scope:situation.situation_sub_region:LR_tsm_foreign = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { situation_sub_region_has_county = scope:LR_tsm_county } }
			add_dejure_title_to_sub_region = scope:LR_tsm_county
		}
	}
	scope:situation = { change_variable = { name = LR_tsm_count_foreign add = 1 } }
}

# Needs scope:situation and scope:LR_tsm_county: takes the county out of every sub-region
LR_tsm_remove_from_all_effect = {
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_hellenistic }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_roman }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_themes }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_persian }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_hebrew }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_brythonic }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_galatian }
	LR_tsm_remove_from_effect = { FROM = LR_tsm_foreign }
}

# Situation scope: resets the legend counts
LR_tsm_reset_counts_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = LR_tsm_count_hellenistic value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = LR_tsm_count_roman value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = LR_tsm_count_themes value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = LR_tsm_count_persian value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = LR_tsm_count_hebrew value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = LR_tsm_count_brythonic value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = LR_tsm_count_galatian value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = LR_tsm_count_foreign value = 0 }
}

# Needs scope:situation and scope:LR_tsm_county; the set title picked for the county is scope:situation.var:LR_tsm_pick
LR_tsm_move_to_picked_set_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:situation.var:LR_tsm_pick = { var:LR_tsm_set = flag:hellenistic } }
		LR_tsm_move_to_hellenistic_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:situation.var:LR_tsm_pick = { var:LR_tsm_set = flag:roman } }
		LR_tsm_move_to_roman_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:situation.var:LR_tsm_pick = { var:LR_tsm_set = flag:themes } }
		LR_tsm_move_to_themes_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:situation.var:LR_tsm_pick = { var:LR_tsm_set = flag:persian } }
		LR_tsm_move_to_persian_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:situation.var:LR_tsm_pick = { var:LR_tsm_set = flag:hebrew } }
		LR_tsm_move_to_hebrew_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:situation.var:LR_tsm_pick = { var:LR_tsm_set = flag:brythonic } }
		LR_tsm_move_to_brythonic_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:situation.var:LR_tsm_pick = { var:LR_tsm_set = flag:galatian } }
		LR_tsm_move_to_galatian_effect = yes
	}
	else = { LR_tsm_remove_from_all_effect = yes }
}
